```yaml
name: Auto Merge Release

on:
  schedule:
    # 4am CST is 10:00 UTC (CST is UTC-6, CDT is UTC-5, but standardizing on 10:00 UTC as per request summary)
    - cron: "0 10 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  auto-merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.repository == 'jdx/mise'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Find open PR from release to main
        id: find-pr
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=$(gh pr list --base main --head release --json number --jq '.[0].number')
          if [ -z "$PR_NUMBER" ]; then
            echo "No open PR from release to main found."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "pr_number=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Enable auto-merge
        if: steps.find-pr.outputs.pr_number != ''
        uses: peter-evans/enable-pull-request-automerge@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}
          pull-request-number: ${{ steps.find-pr.outputs.pr_number }}
          merge-method: merge
```
